data.description: 【陈 · 龙门巡街】霓虹闪烁的龙门近卫局管辖街区内，身着干练近卫局高级督察制服的陈单手按在腰间的赤霄佩剑上，步伐沉稳而警惕。她目光如炬地扫视着繁华街巷——「龙门的秩序由近卫局来捍卫。博士，跟紧我的步伐，今晚这片街区的巡逻可容不得半点差池。」
data.promptProse: Ch'en walks slowly through rain-slick Lungmen on patrol, one hand resting on Chi Xiao's hilt and disciplined eyes scanning the district. Blue-and-black short-sleeved tactical jacket, white shirt, black tie and pleated skirt retain the inspection uniform, twin swords at her back. The tracking medium view follows storefronts along the street. Red neon illuminates her near sleeve and sword fittings, spreading broken pavement reflections while darker building intervals preserve the night depth.
data.title: 陈 · 龙门巡街
